notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to Gruul Turf.
Gruul Turf does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Gruul Turf.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
description:
Cast Animate Land by paying {G}, causing Gruul Turf to become a creature until end of turn.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Gruul Turf.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Utopia Srawl triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Gruul Turf.
Repeat.
